description: Denpasar (Indonesia) - Flood Hazard Map (ESA EO4SD-Urban) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). For the Denpasar area short-term flooding close to rivers and waterways in the rainy season (November – March) is typical.The present Geodatabase includes two shp-files for rough estimation of potential flooding zones: a. Coverage: Indonesia. It has 4 files in SHP ZIP, HTML, PDF. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
